speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Guillain-Barré Syndrome with respiratory muscle involvement. The confirmed nerve conduction abnormalities indicate an autoimmune attack on peripheral nerves, which explains the shortness of breath and potential respiratory failure despite the absence of limb weakness or swallowing difficulties at this moment. Immediate admission for respiratory monitoring and consideration of IVIG or plasmapheresis is required.
